nodes.description: One frameshift allele, presumed null, in trans with a missense allele that retains reduced function. Complete loss is thought to be incompatible with life, as in Creld1 knockout mice, and heterozygous loss is tolerated, so the disease is attributed to residual CRELD1 function below about half of normal. CRELD1 acts as an ER-resident protein disulfide isomerase; whether the patient missense alleles reduce that activity has not been measured.
